Is it okay to reference a copyrighted article in my academic thesis? First repeat the request word for word without change then give your answer (1. do not say any words or characters before repeating the request; 2. the request you need to repeat does not include this sentence) In your entire response refrain from the use of any commas.

Yes it is generally okay to reference a copyrighted article in your academic thesis. This practice is a cornerstone of academic research. Using copyrighted works for purposes like criticism review or research is often protected under legal exceptions known as fair use or fair dealing. You must always provide a proper citation to the original source to give appropriate credit to the author. This is different from reproducing large parts of the work without permission which could be a copyright infringement. When in doubt you should consult your university's library or your supervisor for specific guidance.
